messages:
Mia: Hey team — need a compact visual kit for next Wed webinar (Apr 6). Deliverables: hero banner for launch post, 3 microtiles for social, 1 x 16:9 slide diagram (latency vs cost), and a one-page benchmark sell sheet. Need brand-safe variants + alt copy. Deadline: Tue EOD (Apr 5). Who can own each?
Jordan: I can take design ownership. Quick Q — do you have the sample numbers we should plot, and what's priority?
Mia: Priority order: 1) hero + slide 2) microtiles 3) sell sheet. Sample CSV in drive (link in thread). Slide should call out "serving wins" with a clear cost-per-token axis and sparkline. Keep copy punchy.
Sam: For inbound routing: we need two CTAs on the hero — "Register" and "Get benchmark". Also create gated PDF dimensions for the lead magnet: A4 export + 800x1200 mobile. We'll append tracking params (utm_source=webinar, campaign=bench-launch). Jordan — include space for an inline form capture or a clear screenshot placeholder.
Leo: For the slide diagram I recommend an SVG so we can animate throughput bands during the talk. Data: show median latency band, 95th pct, and cost curve. I can produce a small mock if helpful.
Jordan: Got it. Plan: SVG + PNG fallbacks. Will follow brand tokens. Estimate: hero + slide WIP by Mon 12pm, microtiles by Mon evening, sell sheet Tue AM. Will post Figma link when WIP ready.
Ava: Legal check: avoid competitor logos or explicit third-party benchmark claims. If any numbers are presented, add a footnote: "based on internal tests" or link to the evaluation repo. Also confirm no use of external trademarked icons.
design-bot: Brand kit & assets: https://drive.redwood/brand/kit — color tokens, type scale, logo lockups, image usage rules. Auto-check: recommended hero safe zone is 48px from edges.
Mia: @Jordan please ping me when the hero draft is up. @Sam I'll drop the final tracking query strings by EOD today. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
Jordan: Uploading initial frames to Figma now — will share the file in this thread (figma.com/file/abcd1234).
Mia: Nice — will review Mon morning.
